newsitem.title: UK: Courtaulds drops, Merrill cuts to "reduce".
newsitem.headline: Courtaulds drops, Merrill cuts to "reduce".

text.p: Shares in Courtaulds Plc dropped on Monday after analysts at Merrill Lynch lowered their rating on the stock to "reduce" froim "neutral" following its recent outperformance, market sources said.
The stock was down 8p at 462-1/2 by 0904 GMT, extending a decline since reaching 490p on October 4 -- its highest in more than a year.
Merrill analysts pointed out the stock had outperformed the rest of the market by 10 percent in the previous month, sources said.

Last week Courtaulds dropped as analysts at Kleinwort Benson cut the stock to "sell" from "hold" and lowered profit estimates for the company. Separately SBC Warburg lowered the stock to "hold" from "buy."
